correctness.rationale: The proof supplies two elementary tree-metric version-space lemmas: centers in a closed one-star have Littlestone dimension at most 2, and grandchildren avoiding one prescribed arm have dimension at most 2. Every first split among centers in B_2(p) has one branch of dimension <=2; hence its family has dimension <=3. Any proposed depth-5 shattered tree on all radius-2 balls has a depth-4 positive branch at root p and is impossible. Full binary decision certificates in WITNESS.json attain dimensions 1,2,3,4 on orders 4,5,8,16, respectively. The hypothesis-count bound rules out earlier attainment; adjoining leaves preserves certificates. The exact sixteen-vertex distribution (1,7,227,18516,569) was obtained by independent pure-Python AHU leaf-extension and NetworkX unlabeled-tree enumeration with independent exact recursive shattering implementations; the tree counts and every certificate were asserted. The universal theorem uses a structural proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Exact sharp, uniform depth bound over an infinite natural family of metric-ball concept classes, with an elementary geometric mechanism preventing a fifth online shattering round. The minimum tree sizes for dimensions 1,2,3,4 and the complete first size-four census are natural sharp boundary questions motivated by the known small VC and compression complexity of tree balls. Their exact values and the 569 isomorphism classes are not consequences of hypothesis counting alone; the result is more than an arbitrary small finite computation.
